prompt: Which query returns, for each Voltmarkt store, exactly two columns: store_code and the number of orders placed from 10 to 16 March 2025 (the UTC days of order_ts)?

options.text:
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code

WITH week_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM week_orders w
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = w.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

WITH week_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.store_code, s.city, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.customer_id) AS customers
FROM week_orders w
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = w.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code, s.city

WITH week_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts <= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-16 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM week_orders w
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = w.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
